    Architecture & Innovation

    Tech Stack & Winning Edge

    Built using NASA open-source datasets, high-performance web graphics, and machine learning models tailored for space sustainability.

    NASA Open Data

    Utilizing CelesTrak TLE (Two-Line Element) feeds, Earth Observing System data, and orbital ephemeris parameters in real-time.

    AI & Machine Learning

    Neural networks predicting conjunction trajectories 72 hours in advance and optimizing minimal delta-V avoidance burns.

    Three.js 3D Engine

    GPU-accelerated rendering of thousands of Low Earth Orbit objects with dynamic lighting and atmospheric shaders.

    Green Credit Ledger

    Decentralized carbon credit accounting rewarding satellite operators for proactive de-orbiting and debris removal.

    The NASA Space Apps Winning Edge
